The '''Medal of Eternal Valor''' was a [[Zakuulan]] medal and [[Zakuul]]'s highest honor. The medal was awarded to the crew of the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Flagship]] by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] after the flagship quickly disabled [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra's]] [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] defense system, allowing the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] twin sons [[Arcann]] and [[Thexan]] to capture the world's weapon [[Factory/Legends|factories]] intact.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Medal of Eternal Valor was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Eternal Flagship in the [[2015]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
